concerns.text: Task T028 mandates executing a 'non-parametric alternative (Wilcoxon)' if normality fails. This directly contradicts Plan.md (Complexity Tracking & Phase 3.2) and Constitution Principle VII, which explicitly require 'Nadeau's Corrected Resampled t-test' and state 'No fallback to Wilcoxon is permitted.' This is a semantic weakening of the statistical validation method.

Task T016a trains a 'Final RF Baseline Model' on the full dataset for 'archival only.' The Plan explicitly states 'No model is re-trained on the full dataset for final evaluation' to prevent data leakage. While T016a claims it is for archival use, the existence of this task creates a risk of the 'Final Report' (T046) confusing the NCV-based comparison with this single-model artifact, violating the Plan's strict 'No Data Leakage' protocol and the scientific validity of the comparison.

Task T030 selects molecules for visualization from 'aggregated Outer Loop predictions' (the entire dataset). Spec FR-008 and SC-004 require visualizations for 'test molecules' (the held-out test set). Selecting from the full aggregated set violates the constraint that interpretability must be demonstrated on the specific held-out test data, potentially misrepresenting the model's performance on unseen data.

Task T004 mandates a fallback to a specific HuggingFace URL (`https://huggingface.co/datasets/deepchem/delaney-processed/...`). The Plan's 'Data Availability Strategy' lists the fallback as 'the HuggingFace mirror' but does not explicitly verify this specific URL path. If this URL is unverified or changes, it violates Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) and the Plan's requirement for verified sources.
